fieldValues.title: A second meeting was minuted as if it were the first
fieldValues.summary: The November meeting's records had no relation to any of the 10 decision points and 8 tasks the October meeting left open; only shared subjects connected the two.
evidence: Master repository 2026-11-27: 0 relations from November records to October records
Four November minutes look back in wording only (still, again)
fieldValues.body: No stage was given the earlier meeting's records. Continuity needs a stage that reads the series, not a better prompt.
